messages.subject: gl.basic.stats per population/cohort?
parts:
I was just wondering if there's a function that already exists to do this that I couldn't find...as it is my supervisor (Sam Banks, to give him the credit) helped me write a function to do this, but it requires renaming populations as PopTimestep rather than having them in separate "other" slots. 


I want the basic diversity metrics not only for the entire dataset, but for each population over each timestep ( Pop 1 at time 1,2,3, Pop 2 at time 1,2,3 etc ). This is what we have come up with (on genlight data) but it's a bit clunky...I was hoping there was a wrapper that did something similar. 

pop_basicstats1 <- function(x) {
  singlepop <- gl.keep.pop(dat, x)
  Hs_singlepop <- gl.Hs(singlepop)
  Ho_singlepop <- gl.Ho(singlepop)
  Fis_singlepop <- (Hs_singlepop - Ho_singlepop)/Hs_singlepop
  return(as.data.frame( rbind (x, mean(Hs_singlepop), mean(Ho_singlepop), mean(Fis_singlepop))))
}

unique(gl.data.filt@pop) # to get the order the results will be given in 
all <- lapply(as.list(unique(gl.data.filt@pop)), pop_basicstats1)
all

alldf <- as.data.frame(lapply(as.list(unique(gl.data.filt@pop)), pop_basicstats1)) # this is a really suboptimal way to display the data
alldf



Thanks,
